overview: Rainbow AI is a WhatsApp AI assistant for Pelangi Capsule Hostel & Southern Homestay. It handles guest inquiries, booking workflows, and multi-turn conversations via Baileys WebSocket. The focus is on reliability, response quality, and intent classification accuracy.
goals: Improve intent classification accuracy for booking and inquiry intents
Enhance conversation context handling for multi-turn dialogues
Add better fallback responses when AI confidence is low
Improve the booking workflow steps in workflows.json
Prioritize reliability and response quality over new features

epics.title: Intent Classification Accuracy
epics.description: Improve how the system classifies incoming messages into the correct intent categories, especially for booking and inquiry intents.

epics.title: Multi-Turn Conversation Context
epics.description: Enhance the system's ability to track and use conversation context across multiple turns of dialogue.

epics.title: Fallback & Confidence Handling
epics.description: Improve responses when the AI has low confidence or cannot classify an intent reliably.

epics.title: Booking Workflow Improvements
epics.description: Improve the booking workflow steps, transitions, and validation logic in workflows.json and related pipeline code.

epics.title: Test Suite Reliability
epics.description: Fix failing tests and improve test coverage for core intent and conversation logic.

userStories.title: Improve booking intent keyword coverage in intent-keywords.json
userStories.description: Expand the booking intent keywords to cover more natural language variations that guests use when asking about or making bookings (e.g. 'book a room', 'reserve', 'check availability', 'room for tonight').
acceptanceCriteria: intent-keywords.json has at least 15 booking-related keyword entries
Keywords cover common Manglish variations (e.g. 'nak book', 'boleh book')
No duplicate keywords introduced
Existing keywords are preserved

userStories.title: Add confidence threshold gating before fallback escalation
userStories.description: When the intent classifier returns a confidence score below a configurable threshold, route the message to a graceful fallback handler instead of attempting a low-confidence action. The threshold should be configurable in settings.json.
acceptanceCriteria: A confidence threshold field exists in settings.json (default 0.5)
Messages with confidence below threshold are routed to fallback intent
Low-confidence routing is logged with the actual confidence score
Unit tests verify the threshold gating logic

userStories.title: Improve fallback response templates with helpful suggestions
userStories.description: Replace generic 'I don't understand' fallback responses with helpful suggestions that guide the guest toward common actions (e.g. check-in info, room availability, pricing, contact staff).
acceptanceCriteria: knowledge.json has at least 3 distinct fallback response templates
Fallback responses include 2-3 suggested follow-up options
Responses are in friendly Manglish/English mixed style matching existing tone
No breaking changes to existing knowledge.json structure

userStories.title: Add conversation context window tracking for multi-turn dialogues
userStories.description: Track the last N messages in a conversation to provide context to the AI provider when generating responses. This allows the AI to refer back to previous messages in the same conversation session.
acceptanceCriteria: Conversation history is tracked per phone number with a configurable window size (default 5)
History is passed to AI provider calls as context
History is cleared/reset after a configurable inactivity timeout
Memory footprint is bounded â€” old entries are pruned

userStories.title: Fix .rej rejected patch files from previous Spiral run
userStories.description: Review and resolve the .rej files left over from the previous Spiral worker run. These are patch conflicts in intent-keywords.json, knowledge.json, routing.json, settings.json, templates.json, and workflows.json. Apply the intended changes manually.
acceptanceCriteria: All .rej files are removed from the repository
Changes from the .rej files are correctly applied to the target files
All target JSON files remain valid JSON after applying changes
No data loss â€” all intended additions from .rej files are preserved

userStories.title: Improve booking workflow check-in steps in workflows.json
userStories.description: Enhance the check-in booking workflow steps to include proper validation of guest name, check-in date, check-out date, and number of guests before confirming a booking. Add clear error messages for missing or invalid inputs.
acceptanceCriteria: Booking workflow has distinct steps for: collect name, collect dates, collect guest count, confirm
Each step has clear prompt text for the guest
Invalid date inputs trigger a re-prompt with a helpful error message
Workflow structure follows existing workflows.json schema

userStories.title: Add intent classification logging for debugging misclassifications
userStories.description: Log each intent classification result (intent name, confidence score, matched keywords, tier used) to help identify patterns of misclassification over time. Log entries should be structured JSON for easy analysis.
acceptanceCriteria: Each classification result is logged with: timestamp, phone (masked), raw input hash, detected intent, confidence score, tier used
Logs use the existing logger instance (no new logger required)
Sensitive data (phone numbers) is masked in logs
Log level is DEBUG so it doesn't pollute production INFO logs

userStories.title: Fix failing unit tests in the test suite
userStories.description: Run the test suite and fix any tests that are currently failing. Focus on tests related to intent classification, conversation handling, and pipeline logic.
acceptanceCriteria: npm run test:run exits with code 0
All previously passing tests continue to pass
No test files are deleted as a fix â€” tests must pass legitimately
Test failure root causes are addressed in the implementation code

userStories.title: Add inquiry intent variants for room type and pricing questions
userStories.description: Expand the inquiry intent to handle specific question types: room type questions (capsule vs private), pricing questions (per night, weekly rates), and availability questions. Map these to appropriate knowledge.json responses.
acceptanceCriteria: routing.json maps room-type and pricing inquiry sub-intents
knowledge.json has response templates for room types and pricing
Intent keywords include price/rate/room-type trigger words
Existing inquiry routing is not broken

userStories.title: Add conversation reset command handling
userStories.description: Allow guests to reset their conversation context by sending keywords like 'restart', 'start over', or 'menu'. This clears the conversation state and returns the guest to the main menu.
acceptanceCriteria: Messages matching reset keywords clear the conversation state for that phone number
After reset, a welcome/menu message is sent
Reset keywords are configurable in settings.json or intent-keywords.json
Reset action is logged
